summary: Codexis, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for an underwritten offering of 16,666,667 shares of its common stock at a public offering price of $1.50 per share. The offering is an ordinary follow-on equity raise, not a special situation. Joint book-running managers are Piper Sandler and Cantor; co-manager is Craig-Hallum. Expected closing is July 27, 2026. There are no deal terms such as price per share premium, break fees, or going-private mechanics. This is a routine capital markets transaction that does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
